rawContent: While the fashion industry’s involvement in the #metoo movement has been a long time coming - its still interesting how there has been no major indictment of someone re the rampant sexual harassment, assault, abuse of women garment workers in the fashion supply chain. @Fash_Rev

@Fash_Rev Does the #metoo  voice reach them and more importantly how fo they reach it? 
Women are constantly trapped to work with their abusers often forever because they have zero choice and zero protection. The unions cease and theres no one to guard them - so how can we tackle this?

Im not comparing grief- but while the industry banishes (or temporarily suspends) their relationships with photographers,directors,producers in support of models/actors in light of #metoo for a safer fashion industry - i cant help but wonder about the people who make our clothes

i feel like fashion’s participation in this movement while well meant ; could be ignoring a very huge percentage of women who dont have instagram accounts/ million+ followers to hear their #metoo cries for help.
